（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
12/3/17
Shanghai Municipal Council.
March 12th 1917.

Sir,
A rumour which is at present circulating
in Shanghai in connection with the reported
rupture of relations between China and Germany
is to the effect that huge subterranean caverns
have been constructed underneath the buildings
of Melchers & Co in the French Concession,
of Arnhold Karberg and Carlowitz & Co in the
Central district and of the German Consulate
in the Hongkew district, that these excavations
have been packed with high explosives, to which
trains have been laid and that if Chinese
officials come into the Settlements to seek
out and arrest the Germans the explosive
in the above places will be fired with the
result that the houses of the Settlement
and that of the French will be destroyed
and all the inhabitants therein whether
friends or foes will perish together.

100
12/3

Your Obedient Servant,
mumamstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探股）
17年3月12日

上海工部局。
1917年3月12日。

先生：

目前上海流传着一则谣言，与中国据报与德国断绝外交关系一事有关。该谣言称，在法租界内的美最时洋行（Melchers & Co）、中区内的爱尔德卡贝格洋行（Arnhold Karberg）及礼和洋行（Carlowitz & Co），以及虹口区的德国领事馆的建筑物下方，已修筑了巨大的地下洞穴；这些挖掘出的空间内填满了烈性炸药，并已铺设引信；一旦中国官员进入租界搜捕并逮捕德国人，上述地点的炸药将被引爆，从而导致租界及法租界的房屋被毁，其中所有居民，无论敌友，均将同归于尽。

100
12/3

您忠实的仆人，
mumamstrong
总探长。

警察总监上尉。
